unfold.unfolded: Let $G$ be a connected reductive group, $T$ a maximal torus, $P$ a parabolic subgroup, $\lambda$ a weight, $S$ a subset of $G$ as in the paper's standing notation, and $t\in T$ an element of order $2$. Let $Y_S$ be the set of $v\in W^P$ with $B^S\cdot vP/P=vP/P$, which index the connected components of $X_P^S$, let $d_v$ be the integer attached to $v\in Y_S$, and let $d:=\max_{v\in Y_S}\{d_v\}$. Let $\chi^t_\lambda(n)$ be the function of $n$ of the paper. Then the restriction of $\chi^t_\lambda$ to the set of even nonnegative integers $\{n\in 2\mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0}\}$ is a polynomial function in $n$ of degree exactly equal to $d$.
